calls.title: Demo Call with Dmitrii Podshivalov from
calls.summary: Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook) discussed enterprise pricing with Dmitrii Podshivalov, Vitaly Pimenov, and Evgenii Poliakov from a company seeking a self-hosted unified experimentation platform to replace LaunchDarkly due to data sovereignty concerns and disjoint tools (Mixpanel, Metabase, Jupyter). Key pain points included inability to import experiments and lack of standardized metrics. Next steps: Christian will create a Slack channel for support, Dmitrii will share their LaunchDarkly budget, and the team will continue evaluating GrowthBook after initial import issues.
